name: Bellwether
description: A gas-lit estuary city where nine bronze storm-bells on the sea-wall hold back the Chiming, a fog that steals the names of anyone it hears spoken.

locations.name: The Sea-Wall Belfry
locations.description: The great wall mounting the nine storm-bells that ring the fog back.

locations.name: Founder Row
locations.description: The foundry street where every bell was cast and struck with its maker's mark.

locations.name: The Fogmarket
locations.description: A licensed night market that opens only in fog, where names and secrets are traded.

locations.name: Bailiff's Stairs
locations.description: The steps up to the parish court where the watch's writs are read.

locations.name: The Salt Chapel
locations.description: The chapel where every citizen's name is written on salt and kept against the fog.

factions.name: The Founder Collegium
factions.description: The collegium of bell-founders who cast, tune and answer for every bell on the wall.

factions.name: The Parish Watch
factions.description: The wardens who keep the silence laws and can still a bell by writ.

factions.name: The Fog Brokers
factions.description: Licensed traders in names and secrets who work the Fogmarket under charter.

rules.statement: The wall mounts nine bells and no more; casting a tenth is treason against the parish.
In fog, a spoken name belongs to the fog; citizens carry name-tokens and answer to signs.
Every bell is struck with its founder's mark, and its ring can be traced back to the caster.
Every citizen's name is registered on salt at the chapel; an unregistered name is forfeit to the fog.

history.name: The Raising of the Wall
history.description: Nine bells were cast and mounted on the sea-wall to hold the Chiming at bay.

history.name: The Lost Parish
history.description: In a fog that lasted nine nights, a whole parish forgot its names; the salt registry was founded in answer.

history.name: The Brokers' Charter
history.description: Trading in names was licensed and confined to the Fogmarket to keep it out of the parlours.

conflicts.name: The Tenth Ring
conflicts.description: An unmarked tenth bell has been heard in the pattern; the founders deny casting it and the watch wants the bells stilled.

conflicts.name: The Name Debts
conflicts.description: Fog brokers hold name-debts over half the parish; the watch calls it extortion, the brokers call it charter.
